identity_rules.tester_id: Longitudinal QA identity; nullable in approved anonymous/local modes.
identity_rules.event_id: Client-generated immutable occurrence ID; reused for idempotent retries.
identity_rules.canonical_record_id: Permanent cross-system identity resolved through the RWE Master Record Registry.
identity_rules.runtime_instance_id: Temporary runtime/session evidence identity; never promoted automatically into a permanent record.
identity_rules.asset_identity: Concrete gameplay/content asset identity; validated separately from canonical records and runtime instances.
